proceedings.supporting_quote: The 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court initially dismissed the case on 9 December 2014.

proceedings.deciding_body: General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court ruled on 7 July 2015 that the valuation was based on an outdated 2009 report and was therefore unlawful. The court annulled the Fund's decision.
The Fund's request for rectification was rejected on 25 January 2016.
The 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court dismissed the claim on 19 March 2014.
The 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court initially upheld this dismissal on 9 December 2014.

On 30 June 2017, the Supreme Administrative Court granted the request, ruling that because the underlying valuation decision had been annulled, the subsequent sale was legally invalid. The court annulled the sale.
The Constitutional Court declared the application inadmissible on 23 May 2018, ruling that it was submitted after the thirty-day time-limit had expired.

proceedings.outcome: ruled that the applicant had legal standing
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 20 July 2006, the Supreme Administrative Court ruled that the applicant had legal standing to challenge the transaction because he was the majority shareholder of İktisat Bank.
